outcome: data reliability (percent of agreement, intra-class correlation coefficients, Kappa, Prevalence-and-Bias-Adjusted Kappa)
cohort: A subsample of neonates at risk of severe adverse perinatal outcomes and their mothers, originally from a study of Dutch low-risk pregnant women.
finding: The planned study aims to assess the data quality of the Dutch Perinatal Registry (Perined) by comparing its data to hospital records and case report forms from the IRIS study.
